definitions.explanation: Something used to conceal one's true activities or intentions. From a magical straw raincoat in folklore that made its wearer invisible.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}だった。
examples.english: That company was a front for crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}にして⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めていた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: They used volunteer work as a cover to collect money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{慈善|じぜん}→慈善：16940_jizen⟧⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{脱税|だつぜい}→脱税：09000_datsuzei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われていた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Tax evasion was carried out under the guise of a charity organization.

notes:
Literally a {蓑|みの} (straw raincoat) that makes its wearer invisible, from Japanese folklore. Figuratively, anything used to hide one's real purpose or wrongdoing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use ~ as a cover
- {隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under the guise of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口実|こうじつ}→口実：04183_koujitsu⟧: pretext; excuse — a verbal justification rather than a concealing front
- ⟦{偽装|ぎそう}→偽装：09151_gisou⟧: disguise; camouflage — the act of faking an appearance
